name: Vishalgad Fort
description: Vishalgad Fort, also known as Khelna Fort, is a historic hill fort located in the Kolhapur district of Maharashtra. The fort is famously associated with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and the heroic Battle of Pavan Khind. Strategically positioned in the Western Ghats, Vishalgad played a crucial role as a refuge fort during Maratha campaigns.

routes.name: Road Access from Gajapur
routes.description: Vishalgad is accessible by a motorable road up to the fort entrance, followed by a short walk.

landmarks.name: Teen Darwaza
landmarks.description: The main entrance gate of Vishalgad Fort.
landmarks.historicalSignificance: Primary access point used during Maratha rule

landmarks.name: Amruteshwar Temple
landmarks.description: Ancient Shiva temple located inside the fort.
landmarks.historicalSignificance: Important religious center for fort inhabitants

landmarks.name: Viewpoint over Pavan Khind
landmarks.description: Scenic viewpoint overlooking the historic Pavan Khind pass.
landmarks.historicalSignificance: Associated with Baji Prabhu Deshpande's sacrifice

history.brief: Vishalgad Fort, historically known as Khelna Fort, occupies a special place in Maratha history. It achieved immortal fame during the Battle of Pavan Khind (1660), when Baji Prabhu Deshpande made his legendary last stand to ensure Shivaji Maharaj's safe passage.
history.significance: One of the most powerful symbols of bravery, loyalty, and self-sacrifice in Indian history.
